research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free review of shared mathematical prerequisites with original context and non-merge restrictions.

aliases.reason: The scheme fibre product and categorical pullback definitions both first require a commuting cone P→X,P→Y over X→S←Y, with equal composites. The universal property and particular scheme category remain separate; this merges only the typed compatible-cone prerequisite.

Real-time and discrete-time martingale formulations invoke equality of two random variables outside a null set. Conditional expectation, real/discrete index sets and filtration-adaptation requirements are parent-specific, while equality P(X≠Y)=0 is shared.

The (2,1)-categorical fibre-product source requires an invertible comparison 2-cell, and the strict 2-category equivalence source requires vertically invertible 2-morphisms. They share the two-sided 2-cell inverse prerequisite, with the (2,1) hypothesis and pseudocone context kept separate.

The Grothendieck construction of a strict groupoid-valued presheaf C^op→Groupoids is an instance of the Grothendieck construction of a category-valued presheaf C^op→Cat. Groupoid fibres and the split-fibred-in-groupoids hypothesis are parent-specific; the total category-of-elements construction is shared.

The standard étale source asserts an R-algebra isomorphism S≅R[x]_g/(f), and the filtered-colimit / finite-type sources invoke the same invertible unital R-algebra homomorphism notion. Monic f, localization g, derivatives and étaleness are retained separately.
